meta.title: Wave Insight waveforms
meta.description: Gives the AI waveform tools for VCD, FST and GHW dumps and shows the real Wave Insight viewer in a right-sidebar tab. Start with load_waveform(path), then use find_signals, add_signals, set_time_range, set_cursors, get_changes and list_waveform. Tool calls forward the view to the embedded UI. A loopback backend serves the native viewer and reads dumps through the memory-mapped reader; binaries for Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS ARM64 are bundled.
